name: EMF Inspector
description: Physics-based EMI analyzer for PCB layouts with AI-powered fix recommendations.
description_full:
EMF Inspector brings physics-based electromagnetic interference (EMI) analysis directly into KiCad's PCB editor.

Features:
- 12 rule-based EMI detectors covering trace radiation, current loops, crosstalk, impedance mismatches, decoupling placement, and more
- FR4 substrate-corrected wavelength calculations for accurate thresholds
- AI-powered explanations with physics background and step-by-step recommendations
- EMI and RF severity scoring with CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW classifications
- Export detailed reports to HTML and JSON
- Fully offline — no internet or API keys required

Physics Models:
- Biot-Savart magnetic field estimation (B = mu0 I / 2pi r)
- Near-field electric field approximation (E = V / d)
- Hammerstad-Jensen microstrip impedance (Z0)
- FR4 guided wavelength correction (lambda_eff = c / f sqrt(er))

Requires: NumPy, Matplotlib (usually bundled with KiCad)
